extra.message: The CORS filter reflects the caller-supplied Origin header verbatim into Access-Control-Allow-Origin and simultaneously sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true for every /api/* request. extra.message: Frame-busting is globally disabled (headers.frameOptions { it.disable() }) and X-Frame-Options is only re-added when the client-supplied X-Embed-Partner request header is absent.
